purpose: Block the archive from becoming an aesthetic of peaceful hospice rooms.

risks.guardrail: home records must include labor, access, fear, inequality, and household burden
ED, ICU, EMS, nursing home, custody, street, morgue, funeral, and disaster settings remain first-class
high-gate records name domains and review needs without graphic scene publication
hospital/ICU/ED records describe affordances and constraints without moral ranking
mortality data can name categories but cannot supply sensory witness or family truth
pediatric/perinatal records require highest consent and safeguarding gates

test_question: Would this page make a reader more capable of presence, or merely more excited by death? If the latter, block publication.
